response.original_title: Hana3 ふたりのリゾートデイズ・姫咲はな
response.overview: Starring in this work is Hime-chan, also known as Himesaki Hana! ! A glamorous, busty beauty with an I-cup bust, charming with her adorable voice and playful, innocent smile! ! Hime-chan, who is incredibly popular for her rare charm of a 102cm bust and a baby face with a sweet voice, appears in REbecca's image again this year. This time, the shooting location is Amami Oshima. With a double shoot including a photobook to be released by Takeshobo, you can enjoy her charm in both photos and videos. The video is full of Hime-chan's vibrant, natural expressions in a resort-like tropical setting. Pay attention to the variety of outfits, including swimsuits and yukata. In the making-of and off-shot footage, she talks about her impressions of the shoot in her lovely voice.
response.title: Hana3 Two People's Resort Days
